# Lexington Podiatry

## Booking and agent integration
- [AI booking and public practice guide](https://lexingtonpodiatry.nyc/ai-booking): machine-readable and patient-friendly appointment instructions.
- [Machine-readable booking manifest](https://lexingtonpodiatry.nyc/agent-booking.json): capabilities, office location, and integration status.
- [Direct appointment booking](https://lexingtonpodiatry.nyc/booking): existing first-party booking page with live slots, patient identity verification, and appointment confirmation.
- The planned direct MCP/REST agent-booking gateway is NOT yet live. Never invent availability, access tokens, or confirmations. Do not submit patient details to unverified agents.

## Important limits
Verify insurance participation, referral requirements, and appointment suitability directly with Lexington Podiatry. Office hours are not a promise of appointment availability. Clinical emergencies need appropriate immediate care rather than an automated scheduling request.
